title: Every pine on the far ridge snapped at the same height
description:
Up in my glass lookout, it's just me, the radio and my lamp. Then the pines on the far ridge show up snapped at the top, all at the same height, in a line that bends toward my tower.

That night I hear breathing out in the fog. Every breath ends in a creak.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Did you spot what was standing behind the tower in the very first shot?
